event.tagline: Dancing for a Cure, One Beat at a Time
event.hero_subtitle: A community came together — and danced for something bigger than themselves.

narratives.why_we_dance: Dance Infusion exists because MS doesn't stop — and neither do we. The National MS Society is the country's largest private funder of MS research, advocacy, and support for the 1 million Americans living with multiple sclerosis. Every dollar we raise goes to programs that put treatments in reach, fund the science that will end MS, and stand alongside families navigating diagnosis. We dance because movement is freedom — and because we refuse to let MS take that from anyone.
narratives.the_event: On May 9th, Signal NYC came alive. From the 3PM brunch hour pour to the final beat at 10PM, over 100 people moved through the room — sponsors and strangers, dancers and donors, all of them showing up for the same reason. Five DJs traded sets across seven hours. Crossroads Café ran the coffee bar with AOM Infusion. Bella Laser, Freemind, Brooklyn Cyclones, and the MS Society stocked the raffle table. By the time the lights came up, we had cleared our minimums, exceeded our donation target, and confirmed what we suspected: Dance Infusion is a thing now.
narratives.whats_next: Dance Infusion #3 is coming. Bigger room, longer set, same mission. Follow @DanceInfusionNYC for sponsorship slots, early-bird tickets, and the date drop. If you danced with us in May — thank you. If you didn't — next time.
